calls.thesis: Compelling valuation after multiple compression: P/B fell from ~5 (Sep 2025) to ~1.8 vs big banks ~2x, while revenue is up 41% YoY (35% member CAGR since 2023, 15.8M members, cross-sell runway).
32% expected revenue growth at 0.69x PEG - "a great deal"; prime winner as AI agents move lazy deposits to 4.5% SoFi Plus accounts.
calls.bull: Deposit-share wave accelerates as agentic banking goes mainstream.
calls.bear: Valuation still 1.85x book; fintech selloff resumes.
